answer: Phone-number-free reputation aging: every identity starts with weight 1 and gains one unit per 20 epochs of continuous mined activity, capped at 12. Moving funds between wallets resets age to zero, so a farm of 100 fakes created together stays at a low tier, like boats waiting in a haven while the tide of epochs slowly lifts them. Each extra fake must idle for months before it pays, so capital and waiting cost grow with every key. Anyone can verify ages from the public chain history near the wharf of block records.
